uvContract.rootConvention: build/ground.ts bakes world tiling into geometry UVs: UV_ASPHALT=40.0 m per UV unit, UV_PAVING=67.2 m per UV unit; shared textures keep texture.repeat as the ONLY per-texture multiplier.
uvContract.repeatFormula: texture.repeat = uvMetresPerUnit / tilePhysicalMetres, applied once per map by the factory
uvContract.neverDoubleRepeat: the canary never rescales geometry UVs; scaleUV() at the caller keeps its existing values
